units.zh: 汗性驍銳，遣千餘騎為前鋒而進，封弈止之，汗不從，為蘭所敗，死者大半。

translations.literal: Han’s nature was fierce and sharp; dispatched over a thousand cavalry as vanguard to advance; Feng Yi stopped him; Han did not follow; was defeated by Lan; dead were more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Han’s nature was fierce and keen; he dispatched over a thousand cavalry as a vanguard to advance; Feng Yi stopped him, but Han did not follow, was defeated by Lan, and the dead were more than half.

units.zh: 蘭復攻柳城，為飛梯、地道，圍守二旬，石琮躬勒將士出擊，敗之，斬首千五百級，蘭乃遁歸。

translations.literal: Lan again attacked Liucheng, made flying ladders and tunnels, besieged and guarded twenty days; Shi Cong personally led officers and soldiers out to strike, defeated them, beheaded fifteen hundred grades; Lan then fled and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Lan renewed the siege with ladders and tunnels, but after twenty days Shi Cong sallied forth, killed fifteen hundred men, and forced Lan to withdraw.

units.zh: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。

translations.literal: That year, Emperor Cheng sent the yezhe Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, and Duke of Liaodong; with credentials, overall command, and authority to make appointments under imperial mandate, just as in Hui’s precedent.
translations.idiomatic: That year Emperor Cheng sent the envoys Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others with credentials to invest Huang as General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with credentials, overall command, and authority to enfeoff by mandate, as Hui had held.

translations.literal: Jilong thereupon assembled host and arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu thereupon marched his whole host to join the war.

units.zh: 皝率諸軍攻遼令支以北諸城，遼遣其將段蘭來距，大戰，敗之，斬級數千，掠五千餘戶而歸。

translations.literal: Huang led the various armies to attack Liao’s cities north of Lingzhi; Liao sent his general Duan Lan to resist; great battle, defeated them, beheaded several thousand grades, plundered over five thousand households and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Huang stormed Duan Liao’s strongholds north of Lingzhi, crushed Duan Lan, took thousands of heads, and carried off more than five thousand households.

units.zh: 季龍至徐無，遼奔密雲山。

translations.literal: Jilong reached Xuwu; Liao fled to Miyun Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu reached Xuwu while Duan Liao fled into Miyun Mountain.

units.zh: 行飲至之禮，論功行賞各有差。

translations.literal: Performed the “drink-on-arrival” rite, discussed merit and performed rewards each had gradations.
translations.idiomatic: He held a victory feast and handed out graded rewards.

units.zh: 皝記室參軍封裕諫曰：臣聞聖王之宰國也，薄賦而藏于百姓，分之以三等之田，十一而稅之；

translations.literal: Murong Huang's secretary-advisor Feng Yu remonstrated, saying: Your servant has heard that when a sage king governs a state, he keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;
translations.idiomatic: Murong Huang's secretary Feng Yu remonstrated: I have heard that a sage king keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;
